releases.name: A Canticle for Pajamastan 2026-10-31
releases.body: Created the game. It is a top down action role playing game set in Pajamastan, with spells, status effects, traps, a bestiary, gear, loot, a town, a character maker, a quest board, cutscenes, weather, a radar, and a playable slice. A relay screen lets players chat and connect to a shared relay. Early fights were eased, enemies stay inside their rooms, and labels on the town and switch yard were made larger.

jobs.description: A top down action role playing game set in Pajamastan with spells, quests, and a shared relay.

releases.name: Algorithm Albatross 2026-10-31
releases.body: Created the app. It studies songs to find their instrumental skeletons, matches cover pairs, compares two songs bar by bar, and sweeps tempo to line them up. You can mark pairs as confirmed or rejected so the matching learns from you. It runs with a small server that comes with an install script.

jobs.description: Finds instrumental skeletons and cover pairs in songs, with bar by bar comparison and a tempo sweep.

releases.name: Tomatomo 2026-10-31
releases.body: Created the app. It is a pocket pet handheld game where you hatch an egg, feed your pet, play with it, clean up after it, and put it to sleep. The pet grows and can evolve. You can rename it or start over with a new egg.

jobs.description: A pocket pet handheld game where you hatch, feed, and raise a pet.

releases.name: Coffee Autosim 2026-10-30
releases.body: Added a rearrangeable floor. A new Rearrange button lets you drag stations, counters, and fixtures to wherever they flow best, and the layout is remembered when you reload. Baristas walk to the new positions. Text and contrast were made easier to read.

jobs.description: A live blueprint simulator of a coffee shop floor with baristas.

releases.name: Mill-ionaire 2026-10-30
releases.body: Added a cash out button that sends your score to the shared high score board. You can add an optional link beside your tag, and it shows under the tag on the board. High scores now have a place in the menu.

jobs.description: A letter shop tycoon built around a simulated knee mill that grows into a factory.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-10-31
releases.body: Added GO navigation. The route banner sits below the tabs with zoom buttons under it, and a Google Maps button hands the destination to Google Maps. The bottom panel now stays above the phone keyboard.

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.

releases.name: App Index 2026-10-31
releases.body: Added link rain, where every free link falls as a raindrop colored by category. A Free Links page is now hosted on its own site. The index was synced with the live deployments and retired apps were dropped.

jobs.description: An index page that lists every app with its age, phone tags, and notes.

releases.name: Mind Globe 2026-10-31
releases.body: Added world presets, so you can start the globe from Earth continents or a checkerboard.

jobs.description: A 3D globe where your notes become land.

releases.name: FogWarren 2026-10-31
releases.body: Version two sends your score, initials, and a site link to the shared score hub. Added a High Scores board.

jobs.description: A retro desktop fog of war maze game with mines and a hidden picture.

releases.name: The Aliens Win 2026-10-31
releases.body: Added a handoff document for the project. The game itself did not change.

jobs.description: An arcade shooter where you fly a UFO against waves.

releases.name: Cat Command Chat 2026-10-31
releases.body: Added extra message sounds and look controls under About. Added a Tomatomo mode skin that gives the chat a pocket pet handheld look with pixel pets for every member.

jobs.description: A private group chat app with reactions, voice notes, chess, GIFs, and notifications.
